authorityModes.sandbox: Ordinary commands execute inside unchanged per-invocation native limits without extra model review
authorityModes.scopedPermissions: Structured approval carries the exact requested delta without a second UI prompt
authorityModes.commandRule: Every safely split segment must have an allow rule; a trusted matched command gets invocation-scoped filesystem/network authority, with absolute controller denies retained
authorityModes.reviewedCommand: Explicit bash sandbox_permissions=require_escalated without additional_permissions requests one full command review; structured approval or manual once approval required; no caching of this authority

contractAddendum.PermissionProfile: Optional readOnlyPaths distinguishes reviewable base metadata restrictions from absolute denyRead/denyWrite
contractAddendum.ExecutionAuthority: Added reviewed-command alongside command-rule and scoped-permissions
contractAddendum.privateIPC: Version-1 network-request/network-response frames are only accepted on the broker-controller channel; WorkerFrame decoder still rejects them

ruleCompatibility.format: Literal prefix_rule(pattern,decision,justification,match,not_match) declarations, comments, trailing commas, single/double strings, alternatives
ruleCompatibility.precedence: forbidden > prompt > allow; unsupported scripts match exact outer shell argv
ruleCompatibility.legacy: commandRules prefix/allow/ask/deny is adapted to allow/prompt/forbidden; no general Starlark evaluation
ruleCompatibility.startup: Explicit trusted ruleFiles; parsed before guard readiness; revision includes their parsed content

filesystemMatrix.wildcard: Shared matchesDomain in policy and final configuration; positive native wildcard control
filesystemMatrix.readWriteClassification: cat .git/HEAD and ls .git no longer consult denyWrite; mutation still does
filesystemMatrix.defaults: Read / except explicit credential/controller denies; workspace and configured temporary roots writable; metadata protected as read-only
filesystemMatrix.metadata: Owned .agents exact file grant passed at OS boundary and sibling remained unchanged; default .git pointer/worktree paths and .agents/.codex discovery verified by policy fixtures
filesystemMatrix.scopedMetadata: When lifting a base metadata deny, the invocation loses broad workspace write roots and receives only explicit write targets to avoid opening siblings

networkMatrix.runtime: Broker callback sends exact host/port to the controller for the already-running originating action
networkMatrix.identity: Original final command, source, cwd, session, policy and originatingActionDigest accompany runtime destination
networkMatrix.cancellation: Controller/caller/invocation lifetime cancels reviews and proxy requests; terminal command never replays earlier effects
networkMatrix.isolation: Each invocation owns a separate broker; denied and subsequent requests did not reach owned service

effectEvidence.outsideWrite: Structured allow changed one owned outside sentinel; subsequent denial and never policy left it unchanged
effectEvidence.fullCommand: Default script stayed confined; explicit reviewed command and trusted exact prefix changed owned sentinel
effectEvidence.absoluteDenial: Full command still could not read protected owned credential marker
effectEvidence.network: Exact runtime destination reached owned Unix socket service once; pre-request file append occurred once

compatibilityLimits: Controller code, dependency roots, configured credential/policy paths remain absolute denies even for command authority; no unguarded host fallback
sandbox-runtime mandatory protections (such as Git hooks and shell startup files) remain enabled; this is a recorded native-backend difference, not a claim of unrestricted Codex product parity
General Starlark execution and new external tool surfaces are excluded

corrections: Linux shell creation discloses the existing-parent native write scope before review.
Implicit runtime scratch/log writes are denied outside the admitted roots. A narrower SDK scope inside an implicit runtime root fails closed; policy asks for the actual enclosing native scope.

reproduction.after: Both verified platforms deny the implicit write and narrow-grant widening, execute the disclosed directory grant, and deny the following unapproved call.
reproduction.ownedFixture: Unique sentinel under /tmp/claude; only that owned temporary directory was removed.
